notes: Corrected: the anticipatory 'it' of 'it is not meet for us to see' is the expletive for the extraposed infinitive subject and is its own added unit under rules 20 and 25; אֲרִיךְ keeps 'is meet'. The four-morpheme כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי → 'because' unit was reviewed and retained as genuinely indivisible: one English word carries the whole compound and no morpheme owns a part of it.
